pages.title: Why HiParcelo
pages.body:
YOU KNOW THE MOMENT

You’ve already found a way around it.

You untangle the cable. Rearrange the drawer. Add one more step to a morning that already has enough of them. Nothing dramatic. Just one of those little things you’ve learned to work around.

Then you see an idea and know exactly where you’d use it. You can almost picture that part of your day going differently.

That quiet “oh, that would help” is the feeling behind HiParcelo.

01 / THE RECOGNITION

A good find starts before you find it.

It starts with a job you repeat, a space that doesn’t quite work or a workaround you’ve stopped questioning. We’re interested in items with a clear place in those moments.

02 / THE REAL-LIFE FIT

You can picture using it. Now check the picture.

The size of your shelf. What comes in the box. The materials, setup and limits. These details decide whether an appealing idea becomes something you reach for. They deserve space alongside the demonstration.

03 / THE WHOLE EXPERIENCE

The parcel is part of the purchase.

So are the days before it arrives, the cost of getting it to you and knowing where to turn if something needs attention. Our first offer will bring those details together before orders open.

THE FEELING WE’RE HERE FOR

You reach for it, it has a job to do, and you’re glad you found it.

HiParcelo ✳

Starting with one find.

We’re preparing our first focused offer. There is nothing to order or reserve yet. Its page will bring together the actual item, the useful details and what to expect after choosing.

pages.title: Ask HiParcelo
pages.body:
One question is enough.

Tell us what you’re looking at and the detail you need help with. A measurement, a delivery question or a quick “would this work with…?” is a good place to start.

Email support@entity-e.com or use the contact form on this page.

If it’s about an order

Include your order number if you have it, the email address used for the order and a short description of what happened. Relevant photos can help explain a damaged or incorrect item.

If it’s about choosing

Name the item and tell us where or how you hope to use it. We can explain the information available and tell you when a detail still needs confirmation.

A quick note before you send

Keep payment-card details, passwords, verification codes, identity documents and sensitive health information out of your message. See our privacy information.

The first offer isn’t available to order yet. Support hours and response times have not been confirmed.
pages.purpose: Lower the effort of asking and collect only the context needed for a useful reply.
pages.description: A product detail, delivery question or order concern? Ask HiParcelo. A short message is enough.

pages.title: Delivery information
pages.body:
The waiting is part of the experience.

It helps to know what is happening between choosing something and receiving it. Here is how to read the journey, and where the actual delivery details will appear.

Where we deliver

The destination and delivery route for the first offer are still being confirmed. Orders and shipping aren’t available yet.

The estimate that matters is order to arrival.

Packing and dispatch, international transport, customs handling and local delivery can all take time. A carrier’s travel time alone may not cover the full wait.

Before the first offer goes on sale, its delivery information will state the supported destination, processing and delivery estimates, shipping cost and any relevant customs or import arrangements.

About the journey on our homepage

The scenes illustrate a parcel’s route. The 2 + 7 + 2 days are an example, not a confirmed delivery estimate. The images don’t document our warehouse, carrier or a customer’s order. Use the delivery information for the actual offer when it becomes available.

When there is an order to follow

The order-status link in the confirmation email is the starting point for available shipment updates. A shipping label can exist before the carrier receives the parcel, so a first movement scan may appear later.

A delivery detail you want to ask about?

Tell us your question. For an actual order, include the order number if you have it. A delay, address issue or missing parcel needs to be checked against the order’s information.
pages.purpose: Set a useful expectation for the full wait and distinguish the illustrated route from delivery evidence.
pages.description: Understand processing, transit, customs and local delivery. The first HiParcelo route is in preparation; the illustrated timing is an example.

Before a purchase is available

pages.title: Good to know
pages.body:
You can like the idea and still have a question.

Will it fit? What comes with it? Is it simple to look after? These short guides help you bring the idea into the place you actually plan to use it.

What will I actually get?

Five answers to have before a parcel has your name on it: the contents, fit, full cost, delivery and what happens if something isn’t right.

It’s here. Now make it useful.

These are general guides. The details and instructions for the actual product come first.
pages.purpose: Give genuinely practical reading without turning the whole brand experience into a warning checklist.
pages.description: Short HiParcelo guides for what arrives, the fit in your life and the first use.

pages.title: What will I actually get?
pages.body:
The exciting part is easy to picture.

You’ve seen what it could do. Now bring the rest of the picture into focus. These five answers help you understand the purchase as well as the idea.

  1. What arrives? Check the exact item, selected option, quantity and included pieces. Look for any accessory in the demonstration that is sold separately.
  2. Where will I use it? Match the dimensions, intended use and compatibility with the place or routine you have in mind.
  3. What is the full cost? Look at the currency, delivery charge, taxes and any separate import charges explained for your destination.
  4. When could I receive it? Read processing and delivery together. Check that the destination is supported and that the estimate applies to your order.
  5. What if it isn’t right? Find the return conditions, applicable rights, costs, instructions and how to contact the seller.

One answer missing?

You don’t have to figure out the perfect question. Tell us the detail you need.
pages.purpose: Resolve the five main practical purchase questions in the customer’s own language.
pages.description: What arrives, whether it fits, the full cost, delivery and return details: five answers before choosing.

pages.title: Will it fit where I need it?
pages.body:
Start with the place you already have.

The shelf, drawer, counter or bag in a video may be different from yours. The useful question is what happens in your space, with the things you use every day.

Measure the part that matters.

Check the available width, depth and height against the product dimensions. Allow for doors, handles, cables, moving parts or access needed to use it.

Check what it needs to work with.

Materials, surfaces, fixings, device models and power requirements can matter, depending on the item. Use the specifications for the exact product and option.

Picture a normal day.

Where would you keep it? When would you reach for it? Would setup or care fit into your routine? Those small answers help you judge the real fit.

A photo can leave out a measurement.

If a dimension or compatibility detail is missing, ask about it. Include the item and the place or purpose you have in mind.
pages.purpose: Reduce mismatch by helping a customer mentally try the product in their own environment.
pages.description: Check dimensions, compatibility and your everyday routine to see whether an idea fits where you need it.

pages.title: It’s here. Now make it useful.
pages.body:
Give the first use a little attention.

Before the item becomes part of your routine, check what arrived against the order and read the instructions for the exact product. Keep small parts and packaging away from children and pets while unpacking.

Get familiar with its job.

Check setup, intended use, compatibility and any warnings. Use the item as directed. If it appears damaged or unsafe, stop using it and ask for help.

Care belongs to the actual material.

Cleaning, storage, charging and maintenance requirements vary. Follow the product’s instructions rather than assuming that a method suitable for another item will work here.

Keep the useful details close.

Save the order confirmation and product instructions. They make it easier to identify the item if you need help later.

Something not as expected?

Tell us what happened, with the order reference if you have it. A short explanation and relevant photos can help make the question clear.
pages.purpose: Support the first successful use and make help after arrival easy to request.
pages.description: The steps between opening a parcel and making a useful find part of your day: setup, instructions and care.
